tools.name: search_player
tools.description: Find an athlete DARIMARKET tracks and get the slug the stats tools need. Use when the user names an NFL, college football, NBA, WNBA, MLB or NHL player and you need their recent stats, team or next game. Sports: NFL (NFL), CFB (College football), NHL (NHL), MLB (MLB), NBA (NBA), WNBA (WNBA).

tools.description: Use when the user asks what games are on today or tonight in the NFL, college football, NBA, WNBA, MLB or NHL, or wants a matchup and its start time (Eastern). Links to each sport's stats page on darimarket.us.
